Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC -1 Conditions for Supply, Installation and Fixing of Geysers Experience Requirement The bidder shall have successfully executed similar works involving the supply, installation, dismantling, or replacement of geyser for Government Departments , PSUs, or other reputed organizations during the period specified in the bid. Technical Competency: The bidder shall possess the necessary technical exp ertise, tools, and skilled manpower for the safe installation, fixing, testing, and c ommissioning of geysers. Safe Installation: The bidder shall ensure that the installation of geysers is ca rried out without causing any damage to the existing building structure, walls, c eilings, plumbing lines, electrical installations, or other infrastructure. Dismantling of Existing Geysers: Wherever applicable, the bidder shall be r esponsible for the safe dismantling and removal of existing geysers before insta lling the new units. The dismantled geysers and associated materials shall be h anded over to the department at the designated location. Electrical and Plumbing Safety: The bidder shall ensure proper electrical co nnections, earthing, water inlet and outlet connections, and leak-proof installati on in accordance with applicable safety standards and the manufacturer's instr uctions. Repair of Damages: Any damage caused to the building, electrical wiring, plu mbing, or other infrastructure during dismantling or installation shall be rectifie d by the bidder at their own cost, without any additional financial liability to the department. Security Clearance: For installations in high-security areas, the bidder shall b e responsible for arranging police verification and obtaining the necessary secu rity clearances for all technicians before deployment, as required by the concer ned authorities.

Testing and Commissioning: The bidder shall test each installed geyser for p roper functioning, water leakage, electrical safety, and operational performance before handing it over to the department. Warranty and After-Sales Service: The bidder shall ensure the applicable m anufacturer's warranty for 02 years and provide necessary installation-related s upport in accordance with the terms and conditions of the GeM bid. Compliance with GeM Conditions: The bidder shall comply with all applicabl e GeM terms, technical specifications, statutory requirements, and safety stand ards relevant to the supply and installation of geysers. Makes: Approved Makes of ADG(P) Chennai are only accepted. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
